correctness.rationale: All nonempty candidate subsets (2,097,151) are tested against the independent common-neighbor predicate; 18,494 face masks are exhaustively identified. A reproducible 9,120-pair matching is verified acyclic on all 98,805 Hasse incidences and has critical vector (1 in degree 0, 246 in degree 3, 7 in degree 4). The seven integral Morse d4 columns vanish identically by signed unit pivot elimination and independently computed signed gradient paths, with exact arbitrary-precision integers. No other critical degrees exist. The 3-skeleton is a wedge of S3 and pi3 to H3 is an isomorphism; zero attaching-degree columns imply seven null 4-cell attachments, proving the full integral wedge equivalence. The completed package contains and replays the proof checker and data.

value.rationale: The natural 21-vertex triangular graph T7 is the first known mixed-dimensional open-neighborhood homology instance in the canonical triangular-graph family. Computing the actual integral 4-cell attaching maps upgrades an existing mod-two rank table to a torsion-free integral homotopy classification, a meaningful outstanding topological distinction. The fact involves a canonical graph and invariant, not an arbitrary numerical slice; it does not overclaim a larger-parameter theorem.
